description: Reviewed dated discrete-plate directional evidence and mill developments. Survey-based readings are identified with limitations; other metrics remain unverified until comparable plate-specific evidence is available.

observations.basis: SMU's late-October buyer survey reported that sheet and plate mill lead times continued to lengthen; plate exceeded its 2021 peak and set a record for its survey series beginning in 2018. Its October 16 report placed average plate lead times at 11 weeks.
observations.limitation: Survey-based U.S. market trend, not a guaranteed lead time from any specific plate mill, grade or thickness. The 11-week average was reported October 16, not October 29.
observations.verification: Reviewed SMU reporting; late-October survey described explicitly increasing plate lead times.

source.title: Mill lead times climb to new highs, buyers expect little relief

observations.basis: SMU reported shrinking remaining 2026 domestic spot tonnage for plate and sheet, with steel buyers struggling to find domestic mills offering spot availability. This indicates tightening spot access, not a measured decline in total U.S. plate production.
observations.limitation: Qualitative buyer reports; cannot infer exact mill allocation percentages or all-grade availability. Supply direction here refers to domestic spot-order availability.
observations.verification: Reviewed SMU late-October reporting on domestic plate spot availability.

source.title: Sheet and plate price gains accelerate as 2026 tons dry up

mill_developments.summary: A public report quoting JSW’s CEO described a planned 45-day Baytown plate-mill outage starting in September for upgrades. Completion and present production status have not been verified; the scheduled duration is not a restart confirmation.
mill_developments.status: Historical reported plan; current status unverified

source.publisher: Steel Market Update, quoting JSW management
source.title: JSW Steel USA moves 45-day outage to September

mill_developments.date_kind: reporting period end; changes described in the Q3 10-Q
mill_developments.summary: The Q3 2026 filing describes idling the Gary plate finishing line and one Burns Harbor plate mill during Q2, consolidating capabilities at one Burns Harbor mill. The company said capability and steel output were not compromised. This is a dated footprint change, not proof of current spot availability or allocations.
mill_developments.verification_anchor: idling our Gary plate finishing line
mill_developments.status: Dated company filing; current availability unverified
